short.en: Add a gate outside the part

t.zh: 山区的城市里，有些路口被落石堵住了（带斜纹的格子），任何路线都不能经过它。
t.en: In a mountain city, some crossings are blocked by fallen rocks (the hatched cells), and no route may pass through them.

t.zh: 托盘里有<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>：把「上」「左」两个口的数加起来，「起」口是「是」时再加 1。
t.en: The tray holds the <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>: it adds up its “up” and “left” ports, plus 1 when its “start” port is “yes”.

t.zh: 这一关的「本格信息」里多了「是石头」，托盘里也多了一个新元件：拦截闸。它和放行闸正好相反：条件是「是」时，输出「—」；否则把数原样放过去。
t.en: This level’s This cell panel adds “is rock”, and the tray has a new component: the Block gate. It is the exact opposite of the Pass gate: when its condition is “yes” it outputs “—”; otherwise it lets the number through unchanged.

t.zh: 想一想：从起点走到石头格，有几条真正走得通的路线？石头格应该输出什么？
t.en: Think about it: how many routes from the start to a rock cell can actually be traveled? What should a rock cell output?

goal.zh: 只能往右或往下走，任何路线都不能经过石头格（带斜纹）。让机器人在有落石的城市里也算对路线数。
goal.en: Only right or down, and no route may pass through a rock cell (hatched). Have the robot count the routes correctly in cities with rockfalls too.

how.zh: 路线计数器在托盘里，可以直接放上电路板。
how.en: The Route Counter is in the tray, ready to go on the board.

hints.zh: 路线不能经过石头。从起点走到石头格，有几条走得通的路线？
hints.en: Routes can’t pass through rocks. How many routes from the start can actually get to a rock cell?

hints.zh: 放一个路线计数器和一个拦截闸：本格信息的「是石头」接拦截闸的条件口，数口接路线计数器，再把拦截闸接到「本格」。
hints.en: Place a Route Counter and a Block gate: wire This cell’s “is rock” to the gate’s condition port and the Route Counter into its number port, then wire the Block gate to “this cell”.

body.zh: 石头格输出「—」之后，所有经过它的路线都被「掐断」了：汇合器会跳过「—」，它对后面的格子毫无贡献。
body.en: Once a rock cell outputs “—”, every route through it is cut off: Mergers skip “—”, so it adds nothing to the cells after it.

body.zh: 路线计数器里面一点都不用改。你只是在它外面加了一道闸。造好的零件可以直接拿来用，再加一点新东西，去适应新情况。
body.en: Nothing inside the Route Counter had to change. You just added a gate outside it. A finished part can be used as it is, with a little something new added to handle a new situation.

note.zh: 走不通的格子输出「—」，经过它的路线就全被排除了。
note.en: A cell that can’t be passed outputs “—”, which rules out every route through it.
